name: Anirudh2141-DS/LLM-Reliability-Evaluation-and-Council-Chat
description: Reproducible evaluation and governance framework for RAG-LLM systems. Runs controlled experiments across retrieval, context construction, and generation; logs full audit traces; detects hallucination, leakage, injection, and policy violations; and applies a multi-model “LLM Council” to risk-gate outputs with reliability metrics.
